description: Connect your lolcv account to find and read your CVs and cover letters, prepare tailored drafts from content you approve, and search job listings with source links. Choose from 98 CV templates, including 32 Pro designs, or 13 cover-letter designs. Restyle a CV into a separate copy while keeping the original. Pro identifies a design collection; all listed templates are currently selectable. Job filters may be sent to external providers; results may be cached or incomplete. Separate permissions control CVs, cover letters and job search. Open drafts in lolcv to review the layout, edit and export. Requires a lolcv account. Does not send applications, contact employers, publish, overwrite or delete documents.

defaultPrompt: Find my saved CVs for a software engineer role.
Help me choose a cover-letter design and draft a letter from my CV. Ask before saving.
Find remote software jobs in my preferred country and show source links.
